instruction.text: Select the carriage that contains the dragon.
The Ferris wheel is turning clockwise. Which turn should the wheel do to get the dragon to the top?

atoms.sound: The Ferris wheel has to do a quarter turn, so the dragon is on top.

instruction.text: Where is the dragon after a three-quarter turn clockwise?

atoms.sound: After the Ferris wheel did a three-quarter turn, the dragon is at the bottom.

instruction.text: Select the carriage that contains the dragon.
The Ferris wheel is turning anticlockwise. Which turn should the wheel do to get the dragon to the top?

atoms.sound: The Ferris wheel has to do a three-quarter turn, so the dragon is on top.

instruction.text: Where is the dragon after a quarter turn anticlockwise?

atoms.sound: After the Ferris wheel did a quarter turn, the dragon is at the bottom.
